description: Exploit leakage and subthreshold current signatures across startup OR-ing devices to vote on which source is truly sourcing energy versus being back-driven, then gate only the voted source into the startup path.
mathematical_formalization: vote_i = sign(Q_forward_i - Q_reverse_i) accumulated over N probe windows.
implementation_hypothesis: Matched leakage windows around OR-ing FETs can turn unavoidable device leakage into a direction detector.
experiment_seed: Run polarity mismatch and source collapse cases to see whether the vote suppresses wrong-way startup events better than a fixed ideal-diode path.

closest_prior_art.title: Self-Powered Collaborative Energy Harvesting Interface Circuit for Stacked Multiple Piezoelectric Elements
A self-powered multi-input OSECE interface circuit for multiple piezoelectric transducers

novelty_claim: Interesting only if it avoids explicit comparator power and still predicts back-drive direction reliably enough to matter.
differentiation: Leans into anti-backdrive sensing rather than extraction efficiency.
predicted_failure_mode: Leakage signatures are too process- and temperature-sensitive to be robust.
